description:
X15 is a 125ft Amsca Marine event yacht available for private charter in Dubai, offering an event yacht with 8,500 sq ft of deck space, a sun-deck lounge bar and two air-conditioned areas with floor-to-ceiling windows.

She welcomes up to 190 guests and is run by a professional crew of 6. Departing from Dubai Marina, she is a great choice for corporate events, parties and large celebrations, with routes past Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

Charters are available by the hour, for sunset cruises or for the full day. Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
